ground.amoled: panels taken to black by amoled()

title.purpose: Dialog and sheet titles, beside the marker square.

body.purpose: All control, menu, tab and running UI text.

body-sm.purpose: Table text, header strips, descriptions, small buttons.

module-title.purpose: The card title inside the ruled header strip.

data.purpose: Dense tabular data such as the hex grid.

shadows.name: state-cue
shadows.purpose: The highlighted or selected row's leading ink bar, paired with the state fill.

shadows.name: tab-cue
shadows.purpose: The current tab's ai top edge.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus indicator on every control; focus-ring-inset draws it inside a clipping frame.

shadows.name: shadow-menu
shadows.purpose: Menus and selects: one small hard shadow beside the 1px ring, above the mosaic.

shadows.name: shadow-overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers, dialogs and sheets: the same, a step deeper.

motion.name: duration-overlay
motion.purpose: Menus, popovers, dialogs fade; zoom 1 and translate 0, so nothing moves.

motion.name: duration-sheet
motion.purpose: A sheet fades in from its edge with translate 0.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: translate, scale, rotate, blur reset to initial
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion a fade stays, travel stops.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ai-filled action in a module.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #1f3d6b); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 13px/20px 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #1f3d6b) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f3d6b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action on the ground, edged in the field colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #0f1727); height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #7c8799); border-radius: 2px; font: 500 13px/20px 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #eff3f9); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f3d6b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: A text field; 16px text under touch.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 28px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #7c8799); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #0f1727); font: 400 13px/20px 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #4a5568); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f3d6b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Module Card
components.description: A hairline-ruled module headed by a strip with the 16px marker square.
components.html:
Recent activity
Three items changed since yesterday.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 12px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--card-foreground, #0f1727); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #bfc8d5); font: 400 13px/20px 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--muted, #eff3f9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #bfc8d5); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-marker { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: var(--marker, #d3ddec); color: var(--primary, #1f3d6b); } .ds-marker svg { margin-left: 1px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-body { padding: 0 12px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: A strip-tinted tab list; the current tab joins its content with a 2px ai top edge.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; background: var(--muted, #eff3f9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #bfc8d5); color: var(--muted-foreground, #4a5568); } .ds-tab { position: relative; margin-bottom: -1px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border, #bfc8d5) 60%, transparent); background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 500 13px/20px 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-tab:first-child { border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border, #bfc8d5) 60%, transparent); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f3d6b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #0f1727); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 0 var(--primary, #1f3d6b); }

components.name: Menu
components.description: A square menu; the highlighted row takes the state fill and a 3px ink bar.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: inline-block; min-width: 128px; padding: 4px; background: var(--popover, #fff); color: var(--popover-foreground, #0f1727); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #bfc8d5); font: 400 13px/20px 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 6px; cursor: default; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item-hl { background: var(--accent, #e8eef7); color: var(--accent-foreground, #0f1727); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 0 currentColor; }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--primary, #1f3d6b); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 11px/16px 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The default style draws on contemporary Japanese high-density web pages: a bright white ground, dense ink text, and content held in hairline-ruled modules tiled edge to edge. Each module is headed by a ruled strip on the strip tint, opening with a 16px marker square. Nothing floats or rounds for decoration; structure comes from 1px rules, tints and type weight.

One strong colour, ai, carries meaning: where you are (the current tab, focus) and what you can do (the primary button, links, the marker's icon). Everything else is ink on white or neutrals pulled toward ai's hue (oklch h 258). State never rests on a fill alone: an ink bar or an ai edge says it in a second channel.

Density is for the pointer only. Under a coarse pointer, controls grow to 40px and 44px and field text to 16px, and those sizes outrank the style. Overlays fade in 100ms without moving, and reduced motion strips any travel a style adds.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink text, one accent (ai), neutrals tinted to hue 258.
Modules tiled edge to edge, sharing one 1px rule; square corners on every surface.
Ruled header strip with a 16px marker square heading each module.
13px body text, 28px controls and rows with a pointer; 40/44px and 16px field text under touch.
State cues in two channels: fill plus a 3px ink bar or a 2px ai top edge.

rules.name: The One Ink Accent Rule
rules.body: Ai marks only where you are and what you can do: the primary action, focus, the current tab, links, the marker icon. It never fills a module, a strip or a decoration.

rules.name: The Held Floors Rule
rules.body: Every built-in palette passes the contrast checks in `packages/themes/src/contrast.ts`: text pairs 4.5:1 (ai-foreground on ai, ai on ground, quiet ink on ground and strip, status on ground and popover, the marker icon on its square); field edges, focus rings, state cues and chart series 3:1.

rules.name: The Eleven Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: No UI text below 11px (`text-ui-xs`, `-2xs` and `-3xs` all resolve to 0.6875rem).

rules.name: The Sixteen Under Thumb Rule
rules.body: Text fields render at 16px under a coarse pointer and below `md`, and at 13px only with a fine pointer at `md` and up.

rules.name: The Tiled Not Stacked Rule
rules.body: A module separates from its neighbour by a shared hairline rule, never by a shadow or a gap with a drop.

dos: **Do** head every module with the ruled strip and the 16px marker square.
**Do** pair every state fill with a second cue: the 3px ink bar for rows, the 2px ai top edge for the current tab.
**Do** keep touch sizes (40px, 44px hit areas) and 16px field text under a coarse pointer, whatever the style.
**Do** read sizes and radii from the style tokens (`--spacing-control`, `--radius-surface`), capping a smaller part to the token rather than adding one.
**Do** keep overlays at a 100ms fade with no travel; under reduced motion, translate, scale, rotate and blur reset.
donts: **Don't** use ai as a decorative fill or on anything that is not the current place or an action.
**Don't** round a surface, overlay, row or tab.
**Don't** mark selection, highlight or the current tab with a fill alone.
